idea-plugin.description:
Enterprise Scope-Creep Interceptor & Legal Change Order Generator

Stop writing unbilled code for demanding clients. ScopeLock AI sits directly inside your JetBrains IDE status bar, intercepts unbilled scope creep across recent Git commits, calculates dollar losses at your agency's hourly rate, and generates court-admissible UCC Section 2-209 statutory change orders directly in your repository root.

Key Institutional Features:

  • Real-Time Status Bar Widget: Live tracking of unbilled scope creep ($/hr variance).
  • 1-Click UCC Section 2-209 Amendment Generator: Emits formal signed change orders (.md) before client merges uncontracted scope.
  • Pre-Commit Scope Guard: Intercepts commits that violate initial statements of work.
  • 100% Client-Side Privacy: Zero server overhead. Your proprietary IP never leaves your local workstation.

Powered by the sovereign enterprise legal tech engine. For commercial team licensing ($199/mo Agency Tier), visit Patreon Gateway or contact Corporate Legal Signatory.
